scope: current SmartDoc DOCX to WPS enhancement roundtrip quality smoke

notes: Old Tk and old PySide6 do not have a successful DOCX to WPS artifact baseline.
The current rewrite exposes WPS as an output target, so its quality policy is checked by converting DOCX to WPS and then converting the produced WPS back to DOCX.
This fixture proves focused heading/body/table roundtrip semantics only; it is not a broad WPS fidelity matrix.

paragraphs: This document checks DOCX to WPS support boundaries.

step1_docx_to_wps.entry: uv run docwen run smart-doc-wps-boundary.docx --to wps --output <dir> --json

step2_wps_to_docx.entry: uv run docwen run smart-doc-wps-boundary.wps --to docx --output <dir> --json
paragraphs: This document checks DOCX to WPS support boundaries.

focused_acceptance: DOCX to WPS must produce a non-empty OLE compound-file output with .wps extension.
The produced WPS must be accepted by the current WPS to DOCX route.
The roundtripped DOCX must preserve the focused heading, body paragraph, and 2x2 table text.
accepted_limits: Byte equality is not required for the generated WPS or roundtripped DOCX because Office/WPS metadata is environment-specific.
This basic focused policy does not by itself prove rich styling, image, header/footer, comment, field, revision, or broader WPS application fidelity; rich focused coverage is tracked separately.
